message.text: Design GrainLedger mobile dashboard in Vietnamese, two screens: light and dark versions of same dashboard. Flat design, calm refined Apple HIG aesthetics, minimal text. White light canvas and soft black dark canvas, neutral gray surfaces; web-brand forest green only small accents for identity. System SF-style typography with clear hierarchy, generous spacing, hairline separators, modest continuous rounded corners, no card shadows, no large green panels, no gradients or illustrations. At very top a rice/leaf brand logo plus GrainLedger wordmark, header takes about 10 percent of phone viewport. Directly UNDER this header a horizontal tab navigation strip: Tổng quan, Thực địa, Nhà máy, Truy xuất. No bottom tab bar. Compact profile and sync icons remain available in header. Selected tab has a small green underline. Content: compact Tổng quan title, 2x2 metric grid with short labels Thu mua, Xe chờ, Kiểm định, Silo; quick actions Thu mua, Tiếp nhận; recent receipts as simple rows. Use dashes for unavailable metric data, do not claim regulatory compliance. Flat content, very restrained translucent treatment only for navigation controls. Compact iOS-like pressed feedback and spring transitions conceptually, accessible readable labels and 48-point targets. Prioritize functional sparse mobile layout over decorative content. Both light/dark must share identical layout.
